note: FP16 exact integers to 2,048 and spacings 2/4/8/16 correct. numpy: in [16384,32768) each FP16 value collects 15 or 17 integers (round-to-nearest-even), e.g. 29,920 <- 17 positions; so a position shares its value with up to 16 others, not 15. Max rounding error 8.
corrected_text: FP16 has an 11-bit significand, so it holds every integer exactly only up to 2,048; between 2,048 and 32,768 the spacing of representable values is 2, 4, 8 and then 16, so in Google's E4B file at FP16 a position near 30,000 rounds to the same value, and therefore the same rotary phases, as up to 16 neighbouring positions (15 or 17 positions per value under round-to-nearest-even), off by up to 8 positions.
